$comment: FILL-IN TEMPLATE — base modes (T2VA, I2VA, FL2VA, L2VA). Replace every <ANGLE_BRACKET> slot and delete this $comment plus any *_help key. Slot rules and allowed values: docs/prompting/h3-prompt-template.md. Submit as the structured_prompt field of a generation request.

shots.$comment_opening_shot: Shot 1 declares the style and carries NO cut_at_seconds.
shots.style: <Cinematic | live-action | 2D-animated | 3D CG | claymation | watercolor | vintage film>
shots.description: <SERVICE PROSE. Composition, subjects, environment, action. May contain reference labels. 1-2000 chars.>

camera.motion: <Push In | Truck Right | Static Shot | ... see the 20-value table>
camera.$comment_modifiers: Leave amplitude/speed null for medium/normal — the grammar omits its defaults. Otherwise: 'with small amplitude' | 'with large amplitude', 'at slow speed' | 'at fast speed'.

dialogue.$comment_dialogue: Delete this array entirely if the shot is silent.
dialogue.speaker_id: <S1 — assign in order of first vocalization, no gaps. Group: S1,S2>
dialogue.identity: <SERVICE PROSE. Character type, age, pitch, timbre, delivery. Rendered OUTSIDE the delimiters.>
dialogue.text: <CALLER TEXT. Verbatim, never translated. No grammar markers, labels, shot headers, or newlines.>

on_screen_text: <CALLER TEXT. Visible signs, banners, subtitles. Rendered in double quotes, untranslated. Delete the array if none.>

shots.$comment_later_shot: Every later shot REQUIRES cut_at_seconds: strictly increasing and < duration_seconds. Delete this whole object for a single-shot clip.
shots.cut_phrase: <the camera cuts to | the shot cuts to | the shot transitions to | the shot changes to | the shot switches to>
shots.description: <SERVICE PROSE. A cut must introduce new information about subject, space, state, viewpoint, or time.>

overall_soundscape: <1-4 SENTENCES. Ambience, physical action sounds, non-verbal human sounds. NOT dialogue, singing, or diegetic music — those live in the shots. Use N/A only for requested total silence.>
non_diegetic_music: <1-3 SENTENCES. Audience-only score: instrumentation, tempo, rhythm, dynamics. NO mood words, no emotional function. Use N/A when there is none.>
